text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: This fashion magazine I borrowed from the library has so many interesting articles…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But a few more pages won't hurt!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Knowing about fashion is an essential step on my path to becoming a dazzling lady.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower becomes so absorbed in reading the fashion magazine that she doesn't get to sleep until a very late hour.
